    formatC(x,
            format = "e",
            digits = 4)
  } else {
    x
  }
}

```{r}
run_glmm_analysis <- function(file_path,
                              split_dates,
                              start_date = NULL,
                              end_date = NULL) {


  df <- read.csv(file_path)
  df$发帖时间 <- as.POSIXct(df$发帖时间)


  if (!is.null(start_date)) {
    df <- df[df$发帖时间 >= as.POSIXct(start_date), ]
  }

  if (!is.null(end_date)) {
    df <- df[df$发帖时间 <= as.POSIXct(end_date), ]
  }

  df <- df %>% arrange(发帖时间)


  df$moral <- ifelse(df$EMO %in% c(1,4,7), 1, 0)
  df$exposure <- log1p(df$点赞数) + 1


  split_dates <- as.POSIXct(split_dates)

  breaks <- c(min(df$发帖时间), split_dates, max(df$发帖时间))

  df$period <- cut(df$发帖时间,
                   breaks = breaks,
                   labels = paste0("p", 1:(length(breaks)-1)),
                   include.lowest = TRUE)

  df$period <- factor(df$period)


  model <- glmer(
    moral ~ period + (1 | 用户id),
    data = df,
    family = binomial()
  )

  cat("\n========== GLMM SUMMARY ==========\n")
  print(summary(model))


  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ period)

  pairwise <- contrast(
    emm,
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "fdr"
  )

  cat("\n========== PAIRWISE COMPARISON ==========\n")
  print(summary(pairwise))
  print(summary(pairwise, type = "response"))
  
  pairwise_res <- as.data.frame(
    summary(pairwise, type = "response", infer = TRUE)
  )
  
  print(pairwise_res)
  
  
  null_model <- glmer(
      moral ~ (1 | 用户id),
      data = df,
      family = binomial()
  )
  
  overall_test <- anova(null_model, model, test = "Chisq")
  
  cat("\n========== OVERALL FIXED EFFECT ==========\n")
  print(overall_test)
  

  return(list(model = model,
              emmeans = emm,
              pairwise = pairwise,
              data = df))
}
```

```{r}
run_glmm_analysis <- function(file_path,
                              split_dates,
                              start_date = NULL,
                              end_date = NULL) {

  library(lme4)
  library(emmeans)
  library(dplyr)

  # =========================
  # 读取数据
  # =========================
  df <- read.csv(file_path)

  df$发帖时间 <- as.POSIXct(df$发帖时间)

  # =========================
  # 时间筛选
  # =========================
  if (!is.null(start_date)) {
    df <- df[df$发帖时间 >= as.POSIXct(start_date), ]
  }

  if (!is.null(end_date)) {
    df <- df[df$发帖时间 <= as.POSIXct(end_date), ]
  }

  df <- df %>% arrange(发帖时间)

  # =========================
  # moral变量
  # =========================
  df$moral <- ifelse(df$EMO %in% c(1,4,7), 1, 0)

  # exposure（目前未进入模型）
  df$exposure <- log1p(df$点赞数) + 1

  # =========================
  # period划分
  # =========================
  split_dates <- as.POSIXct(split_dates)

  breaks <- c(
    min(df$发帖时间),
    split_dates,
    max(df$发帖时间)
  )

  df$period <- cut(
    df$发帖时间,
    breaks = breaks,
    labels = paste0("p", 1:(length(breaks)-1)),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )

  df$period <- factor(df$period)

  # =========================
  # GLMM模型
  # =========================
  model <- glmer(
    moral ~ period + (1 | 用户id),
    data = df,
    family = binomial()
  )

  cat("\n========== GLMM SUMMARY ==========\n")
  print(summary(model))

  # =========================
  # Estimated marginal means
  # =========================
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ period)

  # =========================
  # pairwise comparison
  # =========================
  pairwise <- contrast(
    emm,
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "fdr"
  )

  cat("\n========== PAIRWISE COMPARISON ==========\n")

  pairwise_res <- as.data.frame(
    summary(pairwise,
            type = "response",
            infer = TRUE)
  )

  # =========================
  # 创建用于展示的副本
  # 不修改原始numeric列
  # =========================
  pairwise_display <- pairwise_res

  # 科学计数法
  pairwise_display$p.value_sci <-
    sprintf("%.4e", pairwise_display$p.value)

  # 其余列保留小数位（可选）
  pairwise_display$odds.ratio <-
    round(pairwise_display$odds.ratio, 4)

  pairwise_display$SE <-
    round(pairwise_display$SE, 4)

  pairwise_display$asymp.LCL <-
    round(pairwise_display$asymp.LCL, 4)

  pairwise_display$asymp.UCL <-
    round(pairwise_display$asymp.UCL, 4)

  pairwise_display$z.ratio <-
    round(pairwise_display$z.ratio, 4)

  print(pairwise_display)

  # =========================
  # overall fixed effect
  # =========================
  null_model <- glmer(
    moral ~ (1 | 用户id),
    data = df,
    family = binomial()
  )

  overall_test <- as.data.frame(
    anova(null_model, model, test = "Chisq")
  )

  # =========================
  # 创建展示副本
  # =========================
  overall_display <- overall_test

  # 科学计数法
  overall_display$Pr_Chi_sq_sci <-
    ifelse(
      is.na(overall_display$`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      NA,
      sprintf("%.4e", overall_display$`Pr(>Chisq)`)
    )

  # 其余列保留小数位（可选）
  overall_display$AIC <-
    round(overall_display$AIC, 4)

  overall_display$BIC <-
    round(overall_display$BIC, 4)

  overall_display$logLik <-
    round(overall_display$logLik, 4)

  overall_display$deviance <-
    round(overall_display$deviance, 4)

  overall_display$Chisq <-
    round(overall_display$Chisq, 4)

  cat("\n========== OVERALL FIXED EFFECT ==========\n")
  print(overall_display)

  # =========================
  # return
  # =========================
  return(list(
    model = model,
    emmeans = emm,
    pairwise = pairwise_res,
    overall = overall_test,
    data = df
  ))
}
```
